descByPlatform.chatgpt: Calming Typographic Graphic Design for Wellness Quote Post Instagram square quote post. Subject: a full-bleed soft radial gradient from blush-gradient-light #F7D8CE centre to blush-gradient-deep #E39A8A edge over a cream-paper #F5ECDA textured paper layer with a 20px inner margin, a hand-set Canela Deck Italic 96pt serif quote 'Breathe. Begin.' centred 50% x, 48% y in blush-gradient-deep ink, a small sage-leaf #8FA47E single olive-leaf illustration 28mm drawn in thin line-art placed at 50% x, 64% y just below the quote, a muted-gold #C9A868 1px hairline circular halo at 50% x, 48% y 62% radius framing the quote, and a tiny Inter 14pt tracking 120 mark '— daily ritual / no.02' at 50% x, 92% y in muted-gold. Composition: Centered axis 50% x Rule of Thirds type block at mid 1:1 square type 64% frame, negative blush halo 28%. Camera: Phase One XT 80mm flat-art rig at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tethered. Lighting: Diffused Overhead Soft-Box — 4×6ft silk scrim overhead 1.8m (key even), 2×3ft white card bounce camera-right 0.8m (fill), no rim. Capture One Warm-12 LUT grain 5 +0.1 EV. References: Headspace feed, Calm app, Kinfolk Care. Exclude: cluttered props, flat lighting, plastic sheen, color cast, logo distortion.
